data.name: DM0000
data.value: Unknown Error

data.name: DM0000_Message
data.value: An unknown error occurred. {0}

data.name: DM0101
data.value: MCP tool does not support collection return type

data.name: DM0101_Message
data.value: Method '{0}' returns '{1}', which is a collection type not supported by the MCP protocol. Use a wrapper object or return CallToolResult directly.

data.name: DM0101_Description
data.value: The MCP protocol specification requires Tool's outputSchema to be of type object and CallToolResult.StructuredContent to be an object (not an array). Wrap the collection in an object, or use CallToolResult to build the content manually.

data.name: DM0102
data.value: MCP tool must have a return value

data.name: DM0102_Message
data.value: Method '{0}' has no return value (void/Task/ValueTask). MCP tools must return meaningful content.

data.name: DM0102_Description
data.value: MCP tools must return meaningful content. A void return type cannot produce any Content blocks. Change the return type to string, an object type, or CallToolResult.

data.name: DM0103
data.value: MCP tool does not support primitive return type

data.name: DM0103_Message
data.value: Method '{0}' returns '{1}', which is a primitive type not supported by the MCP protocol. Convert to string or wrap in an object.

data.name: DM0103_Description
data.value: Primitive types (bool, int, double, etc.) serialize to JSON primitives, which are not valid MCP content blocks and cannot produce an outputSchema with type 'object'. Convert to string or wrap in an object type.

data.name: DM0104
data.value: MCP tool does not support enum return type

data.name: DM0104_Message
data.value: Method '{0}' returns '{1}', which is an enum type not supported by the MCP protocol. Convert to string using ToString().

data.name: DM0104_Description
data.value: Enum types serialize to JSON strings but are not the 'string' type. Convert to string explicitly using ToString() or a mapping method.

data.name: DM0105
data.value: Structured = true is not allowed for this return type

data.name: DM0105_Message
data.value: Method '{0}' returns '{1}', which cannot produce structured content. Remove Structured = true or set Structured = false.

data.name: DM0105_Description
data.value: This return type (string, string collection, CallToolResult, JsonElement, etc.) cannot generate a compliant outputSchema. Structured = true is forbidden. Leave Structured unset or set to false.

data.name: DM0106
data.value: Nullable object return type requires explicit Structured

data.name: DM0106_Message
data.value: Method '{0}' returns '{1}', which is a nullable object type. You must explicitly set Structured = false (to opt out of structured output) or change the return type to non-nullable '{2}'.

data.name: DM0106_Description
data.value: Nullable object types may return null at runtime, which violates the MCP requirement that tools declaring outputSchema must always return structuredContent. Set Structured = false to accept destructive fallback, or use a non-nullable return type.

data.name: DM0107
data.value: Nullable object return type cannot use Structured = true

data.name: DM0107_Message
data.value: Method '{0}' returns '{1}', which is a nullable object type. Structured = true is not allowed because null would violate the structuredContent contract. Set Structured = false or change to non-nullable '{2}'.

data.name: DM0107_Description
data.value: A nullable object type may return null at runtime, which cannot satisfy the structuredContent contract. Use Structured = false (accepting destructive fallback) or change the return type to non-nullable.
